WITH customer_completed_orders AS (
    SELECT
        LEFT(c.customer_unique_id, 10) AS customer_unique_id_10,
        COUNT(DISTINCT LEFT(o.order_id, 10)) AS completed_order_count
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN customers c
        ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY
        LEFT(c.customer_unique_id, 10)
),
labeled AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN cco.completed_order_count > 1 THEN 'repeat'
            WHEN cco.completed_order_count = 1 THEN 'single'
        END AS purchase_frequency,
        cco.customer_unique_id_10
    FROM customer_completed_orders cco
)
SELECT
    l.purchase_frequency,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.customer_unique_id_10) AS customer_count
FROM labeled l
GROUP BY
    l.purchase_frequency
ORDER BY
    l.purchase_frequency;
